title: Neighbor From Hell Goes Berserk - Cops Crash the Party!
description:
On August 31st, 2022, at 5:40 pm, officers were dispatched to a neighborhood to a call of a neighbor screaming and causing a disturbance.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with Resisting Arrest, Criminal Trespassing, and Disorderly Conduct.
